title: Human medial temporal lobe single units during a verbal working memory task (Boran et al.): spike times and waveforms aligned to OpenNeuro ds004752
description: A BIDS derivative containing sorted single-unit activity from the human medial temporal lobe (hippocampus, entorhinal cortex, amygdala) recorded with microwires during a modified Sternberg verbal working memory task. It provides 1526 units and over 1.5 million trial-aligned spike times, mean and standard deviation waveforms, unit-to-electrode and anatomical mapping, and trial properties. The data come from nine epilepsy patients and are keyed to the subject and session labels of OpenNeuro ds004752 so they can be combined with that dataset's scalp EEG and iEEG.
methods_description: Patients with drug-resistant focal epilepsy were implanted with AdTech depth electrodes with microwires. Microwires were recorded at 32 kHz with a Neuralynx ATLAS system. Spikes were detected and sorted with Combinato (wavelet features, superparamagnetic clustering), followed by visual curation and merging of similar clusters. Electrode locations were derived from post-implantation CT and MRI, normalized to MNI space and labelled with the Brainnetome atlas.
